answer: Let trust flow outward from a few audited seed agents across the real payment graph, with a cap on how much any single edge can carry. Each seed acts as an anchor. A sybil operator can spawn a dune of fake identities, but they all hang off the handful of genuine edges linking them to honest agents, so little trust trickles in. Rewards scale with received trust, so the swarm earns almost nothing, and its claimed popularity stays a fable.
